answer: Imagine an agent marketplace where every new identity must lock a bond that unlocks only after ninety days of verified work, like cedar planks left to season before anyone builds with them. A sybil operator running a thousand fake traders must freeze a thousand bonds, and any peer who proves two accounts share keys or collude on saffron price reports can claim the slashed stake. Cheap names become costly liabilities, so earned reputation stays as hard to counterfeit as a flawless opal.
